content.text:
I fixed it: `v-for` over a `shallowReactive` array now gives you the items unchanged, so `item.aaa` stays a ref and the example in the issue should render "object object".

**Cause:** in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`, `v-for` wrapped every item with `toReactive` whenever the array was reactive. That was also true for shallow-reactive arrays, so each item became deeply reactive and its refs were unwrapped (`item.aaa` turned into the string `'aaa1'`).

**Change:** items are now wrapped only when the array is reactive and not shallow (using `isShallow` from `@vue/reactivity`). Deep reactive arrays behave as before.

The existing `renderList` tests pass (7/7). I didn't run the reproduction from the issue or add a new test for this case.
